Hi Jenna — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery + procurement discussion: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: Fraud scoring + conversational payment support for merchant onboarding flows (initial scope: ~200 reqs/sec peak).
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms p95, predictable cost per 1M tokens, SOC2/PII-handling confirmation.
- Stakeholders you flagged: Michael Torres (CTO) as economic buyer, Nina Patel (Procurement) for PO/vendor onboarding, Legal team (contract review).

Action items / asks (for procurement path):
1) Can you confirm the procurement contact + preferred PO process (email vs portal) and billing remit details?
2) We attached a draft SOW and vendor onboarding form for your procurement/legal review — any required fields we should pre-fill?
3) Timeline: you mentioned wanting a PO in June if possible. Please confirm target PO date so we can prioritize SOW/invoice preparation.

Attachments: SOW_Stellar_v1.pdf (draft SOW), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (vendor form stub).

Next internal steps from our side: I'll loop Rishi for pricing confirmation and Dylan for SRE/ops onboarding notes. If procurement needs a vendor W9 or reference, let me know and we can send immediately.

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the recap. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

1) Procurement contact: Nina Patel (nina.patel@stellar-payments.com) will own the PO. Best route is email to procurement@stellar-payments.com and cc Nina.
2) Billing / remit: ACH to Stellar Payments Inc., remit to finance@stellar-payments.com. We require a vendor onboarding form (we've attached it back completed in this reply) plus a W9 for US vendors.
3) Legal: we do a short contract review but can usually sign a standard SOW. Legal will want to confirm data handling and SOC2 scope — I'll introduce legal if needed.
4) Timeline: target for PO is week of Jun 22–26; ideal is to have an executed SOW by Jun 20 so finance can process the PO. 

I'm attaching a filled vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx with a few procurement fields filled. We'll route PO internally once SOW and W9 are in place.

Next for you: can you (a) send a PO-ready invoice/SOW version and (b) W9 to finance@stellar-payments.com? I can escalate on our side if we need the PO sooner.

-Jenna
